title: Zig: Structs
description: Define a struct representing a Point with x and y coordinates.

steps.title: Define and Use a Struct
steps.description: Define a `Point` struct with x: i32 and y: i32. Create an instance `const p = Point{ .x = 3, .y = 7 }` and print its fields.
hints: `const Point = struct { x: i32, y: i32 };`
